knock.title: Knock
knock.intro: The server is not answering, or it is refusing you. Enter the code and knock — only then will it let you in.
knock.sent_desc: The door never answers a knock — the only way to tell whether it opened is that the next request goes through. Try again.
knock.not_configured_desc: The knock target is not declared. Knocking blind is pointless: a knock at the wrong address looks exactly like a correct one — that is, like nothing. Add to the build:
knock.fromLogin: Can't connect? Knock on the door
knock.device_none: This device has no credential of its own, so knocking is manual only.
knock.device_enrolled: This device has its own credential.
knock.device_pending: The credential opens nothing by itself. Send the fingerprint to an administrator; until they approve it, knocking stays manual.
knock.tablet_waiting: Waiting for administrator approval — in administration: Devices → Door credentials.
knock.tablet_approved: Approved. The tablet opens the door by itself.
knock.tablet_revoked: The credential was revoked. The tablet will not open the door by itself.
knock.tablet_door_closed: Enrolment works only right after knocking with a technician code. Knock and try again.
knock.device_error: There is a problem with the device credential
